list.text: Kanto TV Station\nYour Best-Loved Shows On-Air Around the Clock!
House of Memories\nMay Pokemon Spirits Rest Easy
It’s restricted access to authorized personnel only.

then.text: People come from all over to pay their respects to the spirits of Pokemon.
The spirits are more calm now...\nBut I still sense something bad in the air...
It's far from here though.
The spirits are deeply troubled. Something is disrupting their peace...
Ever since the the new Pokémon Association President elections, there's been a darkness hanging over this town.
All the TV broadcasts are talking about is the Pokémon Association Elections.\nThis is a big deal for all Trainers.

else.text: People come from all over to pay their respects to the spirits of Pokemon.

then.text: You need a PokeFlute to wake sleeping Pokemon. \nEvery Trainer has to know that!
That was unbelievable!\nSomeone activate a live broadcast from an internal Pokémon Association meeting...
I knew something was wrong with the Association!\nHope things improve now with Agatha in charge.
This town feels different now.
The Pokémon Association has guards everywhere...\nthey say it's for protection, but I've lived here all my life and never needed protection before.

else.text: You need a PokeFlute to wake sleeping Pokemon. \nEvery Trainer has to know that!

then.text: That's quite some building, eh?\nIt's Kanto TV Tower.
I'm so grateful that the television is now back on their usual schedule.
I was really tired of seeing all that propaganda about Giovanni.
They're expanding the Kanto TV Tower services even more.
The broadcasts are non-stop now... all about how the Association is working to improve Kanto.
The Pokémon Association Elections are happening in Celadon City right now.\nIf you're a registered Trainer, you should go there.

else.text: That's quite some building, eh?\nIt's Kanto TV Tower.

then.text: Kanto has many good TV shows.
I knew since the beggining that Giovanni was a bad person, but people still voted for him...
I hope all of them are sorry now.
The Pokémon Association has been making changes to broadcasting regulations.
My cousin works at the TV Tower and says they're required to run only stories approved by the Association now.

else.text: Kanto has many good TV shows.

list.text: This area is under enhanced security protocols by direct order of President Giovanni.\nIt's for your own safety.
